categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: automotive parts manufacturing and food business. The automotive parts segment produces water pumps, GearShift components, pistons, and other engine-related parts mainly supplied to Korean GM and HD Hyundai Infracore. The food business, started in 2022, involves importing processed foods such as olive oil, pasta, sauces, snacks, and exclusive distribution of the Italian gelato brand Sammontana, along with manufacturing and selling frozen convenience foods under licensed domestic brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: In automotive parts, the company specializes in manufacturing engine peripheral components including water pumps, GearShift parts, and pistons, using established production lines in Incheon with monthly production capacities based on 21 working days and 10 hours per day. The food business relies on importing global processed foods and OEM manufacturing of frozen ready meals using licensed brand trademarks. The company also focuses on continuous cost reduction and product development to meet environmental and safety regulations in automotive parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Korean GM for automotive parts and HD Hyundai Infracore for industrial engine water pumps. The food segment serves large retail chains such as E-Mart, Lotte Mart, convenience stores like CU and GS25, online platforms including CJ OnStyle, and food delivery services like Baedal Minjok and Coupang. The automotive parts market is closely tied to the domestic and export automotive industry, while the food business targets both B2B and B2C channels in the domestic processed food market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Incheon for automotive parts and headquarters in Seoul. Its automotive parts are supplied domestically and also linked to export markets through Korean GM's export volumes. The food business imports products globally, including Italian brands, and distributes them across South Korea through various retail and online channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, manufacturing key engine components supplied directly to first-tier automotive manufacturers like Korean GM. In the food business, it functions as an importer and distributor, as well as an OEM manufacturer for frozen convenience foods, positioning itself in the downstream supply chain serving retailers and consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the food business through product diversification, exclusive brand partnerships, and establishing a dedicated food business division with specialized personnel. In automotive parts, the focus is on developing environmentally friendly products to meet emission and safety regulations, securing new items, and continuous cost reduction. R&D activities are conducted by the Incheon technical development team to enhance product reliability and secure core technologies, with R&D expenses around 1.5% of sales.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales in both segments. Automotive parts revenue comes from supplying components to automotive manufacturers and industrial equipment companies. The food business generates revenue by importing and selling processed foods, exclusive brand distribution, and OEM manufacturing of frozen ready meals sold through retail, convenience stores, online platforms, and potentially offline stores in the future.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the automotive parts industry, the company competes as a first-tier supplier primarily to Korean GM, facing competition from other automotive parts manufacturers with increasing demands for environmental compliance and cost competitiveness. In the food sector, it competes in the growing processed food import and convenience food market by leveraging exclusive brand rights and diversified sales channels, positioning itself as a niche player with exclusive distribution rights for premium imported brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported total sales of approximately 9.2 billion KRW in 2023, with automotive parts accounting for about 7.6 billion KRW and food business about 1.58 billion KRW. While automotive parts sales declined by 28.2% due to reduced shipments from key customers, the food business grew by 377%. The company experienced an operating loss of 810 million KRW in 2023, with total assets of around 37.4 billion KRW and equity of approximately 29 billion KRW. The company is undergoing restructuring with asset sales and business expansion in food to improve financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable supply and quality in automotive parts by maintaining close relationships with major automakers and focusing on environmentally compliant product development. In the food business, differentiation comes from exclusive domestic distribution rights for premium international brands like Sammontana gelato and leveraging well-known domestic brand trademarks for OEM frozen convenience foods. The company also focuses on multi-channel distribution including online direct store presence to enhance market reach and customer accessibility.
